doclang.heading: Artemis Flight Directors — a clip
doclang.text: Thirty-four seconds from NASA’s on-camera “Houston We Have a Podcast,” episode 179. Host Gary Jordan interviews Rick Labrode and Judd Frieling.
doclang.track:
Gary Jordan, Rick Labrode, and Judd Frieling, Houston We Have a Podcast 179
Intro
Gary Jordan Awesome. Let's, uh, let's get right into it.
I wanted to talk, uh, mainly about the Artemis mission.
We're gonna dive into the operations inside Mission Control.
But, first, I wanna understand a little bit more about you, your history, and what got you into th-this position.
Rick, we'll start with you.
I know you have a lot of experience with shuttle, uh, and some other stuff as well.
